name: cavemio-announcement-pill
title: Announcement pill
description: "New: …" above your headline that opens into the news: the pill itself grows into a changelog card.

cavemio.usage:
import { AnnouncementPill } from "@/components/announcement-pill";

<AnnouncementPill more="Read the changelog" card={<Changelog />}>
  Agents can now hand off
</AnnouncementPill>
cavemio.accessibility:
- With a card, the pill is a button with aria-expanded; the card is a labelled dialog and its first link takes focus when it opens.
- Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it, and focus returns to the pill.
- The hover phrase also opens on keyboard focus, so nobody misses it.
- With reduced motion the card simply appears and disappears.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: badge
props.description: "New" · The tinted label at the start.

props.name: more
props.description: – · A second phrase that folds open on hover or keyboard focus.

props.name: card / cardWidth
props.description: — / 360 · What the pill opens into, and how wide (never wider than the screen).

props.name: href
props.description: – · Without a card, the pill links here.

useCases.title: Launch heroes
useCases.description: A “New: …” badge above the headline that tells people what just shipped.

useCases.title: Changelog teasers
useCases.description: Open the details in place instead of sending people to another page.

useCases.title: Event and webinar notices
useCases.description: A “Live Thursday” pill that opens into the time and a sign-up link.

useCases.title: Docs and app headers
useCases.description: A small notice for a new feature, without a full-width banner.

features.title: It opens into a card
features.description: The pill itself grows into a card of up to 360px, never wider than the screen, then folds back.

features.title: Or it is a link
features.description: Without card content it is simply a link to the href you give it.

features.title: A hover hint
features.description: A second phrase folds open on hover and on keyboard focus, so nobody misses it.

features.title: Closes any way you expect
features.description: Escape, the close button or a click outside closes it, and focus returns to the pill.

features.title: Focus is handled
features.description: The pill is a button with aria-expanded, and the card’s first link takes focus when it opens.

features.title: Calm with reduced motion
features.description: The card simply appears and disappears.

states.title: rest
states.description: A tinted badge and one line in a thin line pill.

states.title: hover
states.description: The arrow slides 2px on and "· Read the changelog" folds open from zero width (500ms); the edge darkens a touch.

states.title: open
states.description: The pill grows into a 360px card (420ms), centred on where the pill was; the card’s first link takes focus.

states.title: close
states.description: Escape, the close button or a click outside folds the card back into the pill and returns focus.
